label: Positional window around the delimiter in long sequences (late inputs, <DEL>, first 1-2 copy outputs)
explanation: Timing feature: active only from step t>=6 through the first two copy outputs (recall_idx 0-1), i.e. the last few original tokens, the <DEL> step and the first one or two copy steps. Never fires at t<=3, very rarely in mid/late copy (recall_idx>=3, small rebound at the final steps of L=9). Rate peaks at <DEL> (15% of steps) and at late original positions (47% at orig_idx 8); grows strongly with L (52% of mass from L=9, none at L=3). Strongest activations sit at the last original token, <DEL> and the first copy output. Within the window it fires on only ~21% of steps, with a diffuse dependence on token content (mild lift for first_tok w/d, recent j/h/v/x, more digits) that no simple token condition captures; precision is the incomplete part. Captures ~88% of activation mass on dev.
